intro_html: This is the bowl that quietly ends your takeout habit. One skillet of seasoned lean beef, fluffy rice, black beans, and sweet corn, portioned into a week of dinners that each land near 37 grams of protein without wrecking the grocery budget. Cook it Sunday, eat like a champ through Friday.
cost_closing_html: That is about $3.13 a bowl (at everyday cost) versus $10 or more for a single fast-casual burrito bowl. The ground beef is your whole cost, so catch it on sale and this drops even lower.
portion_html: Set the full pot on your scale and subtract the empty-pot weight from Step 1. That is your total food weight. Divide it by 14, then scoop that exact amount into each container. Every bowl lands right at about 499 calories and 37 grams of protein.
upsell_html: High-protein dinners for about $3.13 a bowl (at everyday cost). This is one of many. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons, calculators, and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Buy the beef on sale and freeze it. Lean ground beef goes on sale constantly. When it does, grab several pounds and freeze in one-pound packs. One buy can cover a month of these bowls.
Rice and beans are the cheap muscle. A big bag of rice and canned beans by the case cost pennies per serving. Compare the price per ounce, not the sticker, to find the real deal.
Store brand seasoning wins. A store-brand taco or fajita packet is a fraction of the name brand, and you can mix your own from chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic, and onion powder for even less.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot on a kitchen scale and write the number down. You will need it to portion evenly at the end.
Cook the rice. Three and a half cups dry jasmine with water per the package, then set aside.
Brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks. At 93/7 there is little to drain.
Add the taco seasoning and a splash of water. Stir until the beef is coated and glossy.
Drain and rinse the black beans and corn, then warm them through.
Combine the rice, beef, beans, and corn in your big pot and stir. Fold in the shredded mozzarella so it melts into the warm mix.

head.description: A lean beef, rice, black bean, and corn meal-prep bowl. Fourteen servings at about 499 calories and 37 grams of protein for roughly $3.13 each (at everyday cost).

recipeIngredient: about 1 3/4 cups shredded (8 oz bag) Reduced Fat Mozzarella
steps: Cook 3.5 cups dry jasmine rice per the package and set aside.
Brown the ground beef in a large skillet, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the taco seasoning with a splash of water until the beef is coated.
Drain and rinse the beans and corn, then warm them through.
Combine rice, beef, beans, and corn in a large pot and fold in the mozzarella.
Weigh the batch and divide into 14 equal containers.
